group.title: {asker} asks you {n} questions
group.multiHint: Pick any number; click again to clear
group.editNote: Reopens the whole group; submit again when done

replies.label: Quick replies
replies.closed: Closed — no longer waiting for an answer
replies.withdrawn: The teammate took this question back
replies.expired: This question is past its deadline — you can still answer
replies.decided: The delivery has been decided — no longer waiting for an answer
replies.withdrawBody: The question goes back to waiting for a reply, and anyone can pick again. The message you sent stays in the room.
replies.withdrawFailed: Could not withdraw it. Try again later
replies.undoSkipAria: Undo the skip and answer this question
replies.decideFailed: That didn't go through. Try again later
